app_fee.value: The catalog says a non-refundable application fee is required, but no official page fetched gives the amount.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable application fee is also required.

fee_waiver.value: No official fee waiver for international applicants is stated; the catalog only exempts current or former Illinois Tech students.
fee_waiver.quote: Any current or former Illinois Tech student is not required to submit an application fee

gre_general.value: GRE is required for PhD applicants; each department sets its own minimum score in its program record.
gre_general.quote: Ph.D. applications do require GRE scores.

also.quote: GRE testing is required for PhD. applicants

toefl_min.value: The TOEFL iBT minimum is 4.5 overall for tests taken on or after Jan 21, 2026; the older 80 applies to earlier tests.
toefl_min.quote: Taken on or after Jan 21, 2026: 4.5 overall (4.5 in each subsection)

also.quote: Taken before Jan 21, 2026: 80 overall (15 in each subsection)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic minimum is 6.5 overall, with at least 6.0 in each section.

english_waiver.value: An Indian degree from a NAAC 'A' institution counts only with a 60% undergraduate English course or a Medium of Instruction letter.
english_waiver.quote: if they have completed a degree from a NAAC ... accredited institution in India and have earned a minimum of 60% in the undergraduate-level English course

also.quote: an official Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter may be submitted in lieu of English coursework

notes: Application fee amount and any international fee waiver are not on the official pages fetched; the catalog only says a fee is required.
